name: Sentosa & Sentosa Cove
summary: Island living with resort infrastructure — privacy, beaches, and a toll-gate mindset.
body: Sentosa Cove and island residences trade mainland convenience for gated calm, marina views, and resort access. Families who want beach mornings and international-school drives off-island shortlist it carefully: entry/exit friction, school logistics, and grocery runs all matter. It is not a casual first-landing neighbourhood for most new arrivals unless housing is package-driven.
housingMix: Landed Cove homes, condo clusters, resort residences.
commuteNotes: Sentosa Gateway / Express; plan school and CBD trips deliberately.
